name: Responsibility
description: A detailed task or action item assigned to a participant within a specific category context.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning Stump — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning Stump or an admin/Lead Point may update or delete this responsibility.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name or title of the responsibility.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A detailed description of the responsibility.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current status of the responsibility.

attributes.name: dueDate
attributes.description: The due date for completing the responsibility.

attributes.name: categoryId
attributes.description: The ID of the Category providing context for this responsibility.

attributes.name: quadrantId
attributes.description: The ID of the Quadrant this responsibility is associated with.

attributes.name: moleculeId
attributes.description: The ID of the Molecule this responsibility belongs to.

attributes.name: assignedByUserId
attributes.description: The ID of the User (Lead Point) who assigned this responsibility.

attributes.name: completedAt
attributes.description: The timestamp when the responsibility was marked as completed.
